subtasks.title: Add gated Scout provisioning (permission + kit + onboarding) to Clarity Create/Edit User form
subtasks.approach: In UsersResource, add a Scout section rendered only for Scout-enabled orgs to admins (mirror ScoutUsersResource::canAccess() gate: Feature::active(FeatureEnum::CLARITY_SCOUT->slug()) || session admin_impersonator, AND auth user hasRole ADMIN). The section holds a Toggle 'scout_access' (Scout Access) and a Select 'scout_kit_id' (available kits = KitSettings.user_id null OR the current user's kit) — both virtual (dehydrated, not User columns), hydrated on edit from the user's current clarity-scout permission + KitSettings row. Extract the grant/kit/onboarding reconcile into ONE shared helper (a Concern e.g. app/Filament/Concerns/ProvisionsScoutUser.php, or a method on the pages) so CreateUsers and EditUsers do not duplicate it and cannot drift from EditScoutUser's proven logic. The helper: setPermissionsTeamId($orgId); if enabling and !hasPermissionTo -> assignRole(USER) if roleless, givePermissionTo('clarity-scout'), and notify(new ScoutOnboardingNotification) when !email_verified_at; if disabling and hasPermissionTo -> revokePermissionTo('clarity-scout'); reconcile the kit via KitSettings::updateOrCreate(['kit_id'=>$kitId],['user_id'=>$user->id]) with the 1:1 detach (null out this user on other kits), or clear the tie when access/kit removed. Wire it in CreateUsers::afterCreate (record is the new User) and EditUsers save hook. Add a Scout Access icon column to the table (gated) for AC3. TDD: write pinning tests first.
subtasks.intended_diffs: UsersResource.php: +gated Scout Section (Toggle scout_access + Select scout_kit_id with unassigned-kit options + afterStateHydrated for edit) and +gated Scout Access IconColumn. CreateUsers.php: +afterCreate calling the shared provisioner with form state. EditUsers.php: +mutateFormDataBeforeSave/afterSave (or afterSave) calling the shared provisioner; +fill the virtual fields on hydrate. ProvisionsScoutUser.php: shared reconcile method. UsersResourceTest.php: +Scout section gating (visible Scout org / hidden non-Scout), +create-with-Scout grants permission+kit+queues onboarding, +edit add/remove flips permission+kit, +existing role flows stay green.
